instagram.label: Instagram (your handle as you want it shown; leave blank to hide it)

showRight.label: Show the right side (Ko-fi and Patreon). Untick to hide it without losing what you typed, and the left side rotates on its own, centred

kofi.label: Ko-fi (shown on the right of the bar)

patreon.label: Patreon (shown on the right, after Ko-fi)

rotate.label: Rotate the left side: show one site at a time, fading from one to the next (untick to show them all side by side)

rotateSeconds.label: Seconds each site stays on screen

fadeSeconds.label: Seconds the fade between sites takes

showNames.label: Show the handle beside each logo (untick for the logos on their own)

spread.label: Spread the sites across the width of the box, so the gaps grow and shrink with the box you draw in StreamElements (untick to keep them close together on the left)

options.brand: Each site's own colour (Instagram pink, YouTube red and so on)

textSize.label: Text size, as a percent of the box's height. The text follows the height, so drawing the box narrower closes the gaps up instead of making the text smaller

iconScale.label: How big the logos are (1 is the height of the text)

gap.label: Smallest space between the sites (1 is about one letter wide). With Spread on, the gaps grow beyond this to use the width of the box

themePreset.label: Style preset (the same twenty-two are in every overlay in this set)

fontFamily.label: Font (used when the style preset is Custom)

outerFrame.label: An outer frame round the widget in the accent colour, or the flag's stripes in a pride preset. Untick it for none

borderWidth.label: Frame and outline thickness in pixels. At 0 the frame has a default thickness that grows with the box, and with the frame unticked there is no outline

borderColor.label: Outline colour, used when the outer frame is unticked and the thickness is above 0 (the frame itself is always the accent colour)

fit.label: Shrink to fit the box: when there is not enough room for everything on one line, the gaps close up and then the whole bar gets smaller, instead of wrapping onto a second row or running off the edge

fillBox.label: Fill the height of the box: the panel is always as tall as the box you draw, with its content in the middle, so it stays put in OBS as things come and go (untick for a panel as tall as its content). If there is too much for the box, Shrink to fit makes it smaller

colorPanel.label: Panel colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

usePanelOpacity.label: Use the panel opacity below with the style preset too, not only with Custom

panelOpacity.label: Panel opacity, 0 to 1 (used when the style preset is Custom, or with any preset if the box above it is ticked)

cText.label: Text (used when the style preset is Custom)

cAccent.label: Accent (used when the style preset is Custom)

cTrack.label: Bars and chips (used when the style preset is Custom)

cWarn.label: Alert colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

decoration.label: Decorations drawn behind the words, in the accent colour (or the flag's colours in a pride preset)

decorationSize.label: Decoration size, as a multiple of the usual

decorationMotion.label: How decorations move (with Animate off, or while the sites are rotating, they stay still)

options.edges: Along the inside of the edges
options.offset: A little way in from the corners (top right and bottom right first)
options.border: On the border, half outside it (leave a little room round the widget)

options.accent: The accent colour (a pride preset's flag colours)
options.mixed: The accent and text colours, in turn

decorationTint.label: Decoration colour to use when the colour above is the one picked here

decorationOpacity.label: Decoration opacity, 0.1 to 1 (separate from the panel's opacity, and 1 is fully solid). Twinkling dips a little and drifting fades in and out, so choose Stay still to keep them fully solid

debug.label: Log every event to the browser-source console
